name: MD-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Mfume running with financial edge
No contested polling or expert ratings
model.rationale: MD-07's D+31 lean, Mfume's incumbency and fundraising advantage, and markets pricing a Democratic win near 96% all point to a safe Democratic hold with no contrary evidence.
model.watch: Any late polling showing an unusually weak Mfume margin or major outside spending against him would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Baltimore-area MD-07 is one of the most Democratic-leaning House districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+31. Incumbent Kweisi Mfume is running for another term and holds a clear financial advantage, with about $700,000 on hand, while Republican Scott Collier has reported minimal fundraising. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 96%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no contrary evidence, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with the expected margin near 29 points and moderate uncertainty given the absence of polling.
